name: age-of-anything
instructions: A headless Age of Anything match, the same sim the game plays. creel_start {"args": {"mods": ["steading"]}} for a Steading town; creel_names maps kinds and resources to names; positions are in sim units (1000 a tile).
start_help: args: mods (e.g. ["steading"]), rules (default the first mod's, else "default"), map (default steading_vale with Steading, else reed_meadow), seed (2026), races (one prompt a player, e.g. ["romans", "greeks"]), bots (the players a bot plays: none with Steading, else all but player 0).
capture_help: Extra options as args, e.g. {"look": "40,30"} for the camera on a tile.
